sentences.text:
Date : 06.08.2025 Heard Mr. G. Bordoloi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. M.P. Goswami,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent no. 1, State of Assam.
2.

The instant criminal petition under Section 528, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita [BNSS],
2023 has been preferred seeking setting aside and quashing of the criminal proceedings of Police Report Case [PRC] no. 2843/2022, which is presently pending before the Court of learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate [S]-1, Kamrup [Metro] at Guwahati ['the Trial Court', for short].
3. Issue notice, returnable on 08.09.2025.
4.

entities.text: Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate [S]-1, Kamrup [Metro] at Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As Mr. Goswami has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1, issuance of notice in respect of the said respondent stands dispensed with.
The learned counsel for the petitioner shall serve an extra copy of the petition along with annexures, to Mr. Goswami within 3 [three] working days from today.
5. The petitioner shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 by registered post with A/D as well as by usual process within 3 [three] working days from today.

6. It is stated that the respondent no. 2 as the informant lodged a First Information Report [FIR] on 01.01.2019, which was registered as Dispur Police Station Case no. 27/2019 for the offence under Section 498A, Indian Penal Code [IPC].

After investigation, the I.O. of the case had submitted a charge-sheet finding a prima facie case against the petitioner for the offence under Section 498A,
IPC.
On submission of the charge-sheet, the case has been registered as PRC no. 2823/2022.
The petitioner, on receipt of process, appeared before the learned Trial Court.
After charge under Section 498A, IPC was framed, the case proceeded to the stage of evidence.
The evidence of the respondent no. 2-informant as P.W.1 was recorded on 02.07.2024.
It is submitted that subsequent to 02.07.2022, no other prosecution witness has been examined.

7. It is further stated that in the meantime, the petitioner and the respondent no. 2- informant being the husband and the wife, submitted a petition under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Kamrup [Metro] at Guwahati ['the Family Court', for short] seeking dissolution of their marriage by a decree of divorce on mutual consent.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Court, Kamrup [Metro] at Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said petition was registered as F.C. [Civil] Case no. 1262/2022.
In the petition, mention was made of the case instituted under Section 498A, IPC in the year 2019.
It was a condition of the mutual settlement that the said case would be withdrawn.
P.W.1 during her cross-examination had admitted that at the time of seeking mutual divorce, it was mentioned that the criminal case would be withdrawn.

The learned Family Court, by an Order dated 15.05.2023, had allowed the joint petition thereby dissolving the marriage between the petitioner and the respondent no. 2-informant by a decree of divorce on mutual consent.
In the above backdrop, the instant criminal petition has been preferred seeking the above relief.

8. In view of such fact situation obtaining in the case, it is observed, in the interim, that further proceedings of Police Report Case no. 2823/2022, presently pending before the Court of learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate [S]-1, Kamrup [Metro] at Guwahati shall remain suspended till Sri Sisir Kumar Sarma vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126612149/
